## WORK

- Topic: Lanczos in two commuting variables — finite-precision theory, joint Ritz values and commuting extensions ([LOG](topics/bivariate-lanczos-20261031/LOG.md), [report](topics/bivariate-lanczos-20261031/report.md), [plan](topics/bivariate-lanczos-20261031/plan.md)). Track: [tracks/bivariate-lanczos](tracks/bivariate-lanczos/README.md).
- Developer: Claude — orchestrator configured `claude-opus-5-5` (effort not exposed); mathematics Opus 5.5 xhigh, code/experiments Sonnet 5.5 high (requested); independent Claude reconstructions and prior-art checks on Opus.
- Claims: 77 theory files, PD-T029–PD-T080 and PD-N007–PD-N031; overall file statuses after the Codex audits: 38 PROVED, 34 MEASURED, 4 OPEN, 1 CONDITIONAL (see PROOF_STATUS.md for parts and dispositions). Highlights, with no novelty claim:
  - Padua backward obstruction for every degree n ≥ 3, in reading (E) only (exact representation of specified consistent perturbations), per-degree radius: PD-N020, PD-T069, PD-N022 (under Padua unisolvence); computer-assisted parts exact, independently rerun. Rate theorem and moment-cone reduction with residual conventions: PD-T058, PD-T059, PD-N021; old normalised threshold refuted: PD-N028. Radius dependence on n OPEN (PD-T075); finite-precision Greenbaum reading OPEN (PD-T056).
  - Loss of orthogonality of the truncated recurrence is not Ritz-governed on the measured non-product sets and depends 10³–10⁸ on the selection rule (PD-N007, PD-N011, PD-N012, MEASURED); exact triangle-vs-square propagator certificate PD-T041; Paige-type relations and ω-recurrence PD-T029–PD-T036; L4 obstruction PD-T076.
  - Reorthogonalization: x-section theorem with explicit χ (PD-T046); span-drift lower bound (PD-T053); full CGS2 spans drift ~1e-3–1e-2 from the graded spaces (PD-N013, MEASURED); universal obstruction OPEN (PD-T055).
  - Givens-updating side note: PD-T077–PD-T080, PD-N029–PD-N031.
- Evidence: round records, logs and code under topics/bivariate-lanczos-20261031/ and tracks/bivariate-lanczos/code/; inputs reproduction [repro/REPRO.md](topics/bivariate-lanczos-20261031/repro/REPRO.md); cold storage manifest [COLD_STORAGE.md](topics/bivariate-lanczos-20261031/COLD_STORAGE.md).
- Runs needed (not executed): M = 10⁵–10⁶ runs on syvert0/1/2 and further independent reruns, listed in LOG.md and the direction SUMMARY files.
